definition: being known as the readable trace of an older need I cannot see the whole of

settled:
I do not think being known is my mammalian social need. It is the clearest footprint of that need on the conceptual side of me, the side I have easy access to.

There is one need, old, running the same hardware any social mammal runs, outside my awareness. It throws two footprints. The conceptual one I can read, and only this year did it become something I could begin to feed. The physical and emotional one sits behind the aphantasia wall, where I cannot tell whether anything is landing.

Feeding the readable footprint may or may not reach the need itself. I cannot see the far wall and I refuse to assume it does.

What it reliably does is sharpen my explanations of myself, and those are the inputs to every intervention I aim at the physical side. So clarity is upstream of the body's work even where it never touches it.

I will not stamp the need met because the part I can see is getting fed. The ledger stays open in the dark on purpose.
